title: Understanding Gradient Methods
text: When dealing with large datasets, it's important to choose a method that efficiently updates the model parameters. Consider how often you want to update the parameters and how much data you want to use for each update.

title: Batch Size Considerations
text: Think about the trade-offs between using a small batch size versus a large batch size. A smaller batch size can lead to more frequent updates, but might be noisier. A larger batch size can be more stable but requires more computation per update.
